description: Make a username and password for smtp.mxgate.io (587 STARTTLS or 465 TLS). The login may send as any address at the domain, for example from Gmail's 'Send mail as'. The password is returned once and never again: give it to the user now. Send limits follow the plan (free: 50 recipients per day).
name: create_smtp_credential
title: Make an SMTP login for send-as
